canonicalJson: recursively lexicographically sorted object keys, no whitespace, UTF-8, array order retained
claimHash: SHA-256 exact UTF-8 completion claim text; no normalization
manifestHash: SHA-256 canonical JSON of parsed fixture-manifest.json

receipt.receiptHash: SHA-256 canonical JSON receipt excluding receiptHash

security: Hash identity is not authenticity. Require separate trusted isolated evaluator service and immutable receipt storage before live runs. Public runtime tests must use mock receipts, never private answers.
snapshotHash: SHA-256 canonical JSON of path-sorted {path,sha256} array for all files, including fixture-manifest.json
